summary: Frontend-only verification of 5 targeted UI changes (iteration 16). All acceptance criteria pass on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 spot check. (1) LTO tapes enlarged: .sc-lto = 180x128px on desktop, .sc-lto__label-name font-size = 13.5px, all LTO-01..LTO-05 rendered and visible with category names legible ('Serwery','Macierze Dyskowe','Przełączniki Sieciowe','Biblioteki Taśmowe LTO','Deduplikatory'). (2) No italic outside hero: computed font-style === 'normal' for .sc-statcard__value, .sc-tapelib2__tapes-title, .sc-drive__title. .sc-metric__val and .sc-partners2__title returned 0 nodes on desktop viewport but the CSS rule enforces normal — no italic rules remain in App.css (grep font-style: italic returns 0). (3) Hero accent gradient: [data-testid='hero-title'] .sc-hero-accent text='ciągłości' has background-image linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(6,255,224) 0%, rgb(0,184,212) 100%) and -webkit-text-fill-color rgba(0,0,0,0) — visually mint→cyan gradient matching primary CTA. (4) Switch section: all 6 ports have min-width 150px, .sc-port__label font-size 13px, width 148px. Odd-indexed ports (idx 1,3,5) carry 'sc-port--low' class with cable bottom -184px vs -120px — labels visibly staggered at two vertical bands (~737px vs ~817px). All 6 [data-testid=switch-label-*] have .sc-port__label-clip child. (5) Business Continuity copy scrubbed: no occurrences of 'zasilan','UPS','agregat','PDU','power','generator','prąd' in visible section text. Title 'Biznes, który nigdy nie milknie.' 4 value cards (redundancy/geo/monitor/dr) all present. PDU meter shows '99.99' at font-size 44px with '% SLA' subtext, banks 'SITE A · PRIMARY' and 'SITE B · DR', feed tags 'SITE A' and 'SITE B · DR'. No VOLT/AMPS/32A/LOAD tokens. Regression P0 clean: all 13 required data-testids present (nav-brand, nav-link-about/services/partners/contact, lang-toggle, nav-cta, hero-cta-primary/secondary, refab-server/values/cta, continuity-cta). All 12 section IDs present. No console errors, no horizontal overflow at desktop 1920 or mobile 390.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css is 6173 lines — still recommend splitting into per-section modules for maintainability (already flagged in iter 15, unchanged).

SwitchSection.jsx: odd-index staggering is currently `idx % 2 === 1` producing ports 2,4,6 low (0-based idx 1,3,5). Reads correctly against the criteria (odd 1,3,5 low). Behavior is stable and visually staggered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 covered 5 UI polish items: LTO tape enlargement, italic removal outside hero, hero 'ciągłości' gradient, switch label staggering, and continuity/PDU rewrite. All pass. No regressions detected. Font-style: italic completely removed from App.css. Hero accent uses gradient text (not italic) — matches primary CTA style. Switch ports use idx % 2 === 1 for sc-port--low class. Continuity section copy uses SLA/uptime/DR terminology, not power/UPS/PDU/generator.
